four_core_questions.立得住: Background establishes concrete domain lineage, specific technical bottleneck, and why-now urgency without empty cliché openings.
four_core_questions.分得清: Related work is grouped by problem setting, method route, or evaluation paradigm and compares conclusions, applicability conditions, and limitations rather than sequential paper summaries.
four_core_questions.说得实: Research gaps are explicitly derived from shared limitations, uncovered scenarios, or inter-study conflicts across cited literature, or explicitly tagged [作者判断]/[AUTHOR_JUDGMENT].
four_core_questions.对得上: Each contribution maps 1-to-1 to concrete methods, figures, tables, and grounded experimental metrics with exact scope qualification, and every citation resolves to verifiable metadata.
